lines.text: Ezra gathered the exiles at the canal flowing to Ahava, found no Levites there, and sent leaders to Iddo at Casiphia.
By God's gracious hand, Sherebiah and his sons and brothers came, and 220 temple servants were also brought.
Ezra proclaimed a feast by the Ahava Canal to ask God for a safe journey, and God granted their request.
Ezra set apart twelve leading priests and weighed out silver, gold and articles to them, telling them to guard it carefully.
On the fourth day they weighed the silver and gold in the king's palace, and the exiles offered burnt offerings.
